FAQs

How many terminals does King Abdulaziz Intl (JED) have?

King Abdulaziz Intl Airport currently has 4 operational terminals: T1, N, HAJJ, T4.

Does Jeddah (JED) Airport operate international flights?

Yes, Jeddah's King Abdulaziz Intl (JED) operates both domestic and international flights.

Where can I find a list of cancelled flights at Jeddah (JED) Airport?

Cancelled flights are clearly marked in the status section, and you can filter the list to view only cancelled flights. The following is the list of cancelled flights at Jeddah Airport - XY4184.

Which airlines operate the most flights from Jeddah (JED) Airport?

Saudi Arabian Airlines is the largest airline at Jeddah by number of departures followed by Flynas.

How can I contact the airport or airline for flight assistance?

Helpline numbers for both the departure airport +966 920011233, arrival airport, and the airline are listed with each flight for your convenience.

How can I check the flight status for any other flight?

You can check the real-time status of any flight by visiting our Flight Status page. Enter the flight number or select the airline and date to get the latest updates.

How to book flights and hotels, and are there any offers available?

You can easily plan and book your trip by through our Flights Ticket Booking page and choosing from a variety range of stays on our Hotels page. You can save up to 25% off on your next trip, Use Code "GETAPP". Applicable on flights and hotels.

Where can I find information about arrivals and departures for Jeddah (JED) Airport?

You can track real-time Jeddah Airport Arrivals and Departures for this airport through our dedicated pages. Stay up-to-date with flight statuses, schedule changes, and terminal information, Baggage belt and more.

Overview of King Abdulaziz Intl

King Abdulaziz International Airport (KAIA) in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, is the country’s largest and busiest airport, serving as the main entry point for millions of travelers to Mecca and Medina. Opened in 1981 and named after the founder of modern Saudi Arabia, the airport is a strategic hub for both religious pilgrimage and commercial aviation. Spanning over 105 square kilometers, KAIA features one of the world’s largest terminals—the Hajj Terminal—designed to accommodate the surge in passengers during pilgrimage seasons.

In 2023, the airport processed approximately 41 million passengers, making it a central hub for Saudi Arabian Airlines (Saudia) and a key component in Saudi Arabia’s Vision 2030 initiative. Its location on the Red Sea positions it as a vital link between Europe, Asia, and Africa. Ongoing expansions and modernization projects continue to enhance capacity and service quality, solidifying KAIA’s status as a world-class international gateway.

Key Facts & Codes (IATA, ICAO, Location, Terminals)

Detail Information
IATA Code JED
ICAO Code OEJN
Location Airport Road, Jeddah 23631, Saudi Arabia
Terminals 4 (Terminal 1, North, South, Hajj)

Operating Hours 24 hours daily
Elevation 48 feet (15 meters) above sea level

Popular Domestic & International Routes

KAIA is a major hub connecting Saudi Arabia to destinations across the Middle East, Europe, Asia, and Africa. The airport’s route network is shaped by both business travel and religious tourism, especially during Hajj and Umrah seasons.

  • Major Domestic Destinations:
    • Riyadh (King Khalid International Airport) – frequent daily flights
    • Dammam (King Fahd International Airport)
    • Medina (Prince Mohammad Bin Abdulaziz Airport)
    • Abha, Tabuk, Jazan – regional connections
  • Key International Routes:
    • Middle East: Dubai, Kuwait City, Doha, Cairo, Amman
    • Europe: London, Paris, Frankfurt, Rome, Istanbul
    • Asia: Karachi, Islamabad, Delhi, Mumbai, Jakarta, Manila, Kuala Lumpur
    • Africa: Casablanca, Addis Ababa, Khartoum, Lagos, Accra

The busiest international routes include London Heathrow, Dubai International, Cairo, and Karachi. During Hajj and Umrah, special charter flights operate from over 100 countries, significantly increasing capacity from Muslim-majority nations.

Airport Terminals Guide

KAIA operates four terminals, each serving specific passenger groups and flight types. Inter-terminal transfers are facilitated by shuttle buses every 10–15 minutes, and covered walkways connect the North and South Terminals.

Terminal Purpose Capacity Key Features
Terminal 1 (New) International flights 30 million/year Modern design, biometric systems, premium lounges
North Terminal Domestic & international 15 million/year Saudia hub, business facilities
South Terminal International flights 13 million/year Foreign airlines, duty-free shopping
Hajj Terminal Pilgrimage flights 80,000 (peak) Seasonal, tent-like structure

Terminal 1, opened in 2019, features advanced technology and enhanced passenger experience. Shuttle buses and walkways provide convenient inter-terminal access.

Check-in & Security Process

KAIA offers multiple check-in and security options to streamline passenger flow and maintain international safety standards.

  • Check-in:
    • Online check-in available 48 hours before departure for most airlines
    • Mobile check-in via airline apps with digital boarding passes
    • Self-service kiosks for bag drop and seat selection
    • Traditional counters with dedicated premium and economy lanes
  • Security:
    • Advanced screening with body scanners and automated tray systems
    • Separate lanes for families, premium passengers, and crew
    • Biometric passport control for Saudi nationals and residents
    • Additional screening for US-bound flights

Arrive at least 3 hours before international flights and 2 hours before domestic flights. During peak seasons, allow extra time. Expedited lanes are available for premium passengers and frequent flyers.

Facilities & Amenities (Lounges, Wi-Fi, ATMs, Baggage Services, etc.)

KAIA provides a comprehensive range of facilities for all travelers, including business, leisure, and religious passengers.

  • Lounges:
    • Alfursan Golden Lounge (Saudia) with à la carte dining and business amenities
    • Pearl Lounge and Marhaba Lounge (independent, day pass and membership access)
  • Essential Services:
    • Free high-speed Wi-Fi throughout all terminals
    • ATMs from major banks and international networks
    • 24/7 currency exchange counters
    • Baggage wrapping, left luggage, and lost baggage assistance
    • Medical center with pharmacy and emergency services
  • Comfort & Convenience:
    • Prayer rooms (Musalla) in all terminals
    • Quiet zones, rest areas, and charging stations
    • Children’s play areas and family facilities
    • Designated smoking lounges

Transportation Options to & from the Airport

Taxis & Ride-Sharing

Licensed taxis are available outside each terminal with metered fares. Typical fares to central Jeddah are 80–120 SAR. Uber and Careem operate from dedicated pickup zones, offering standard and premium vehicles.

Airport Shuttle Services

SAPTCO provides regular shuttle buses to major hotels and districts. Fares range from 20–40 SAR. Many hotels offer complimentary shuttles (advance booking recommended).

Public Transport (Metro, Bus, Train)

SAPTCO public buses (e.g., Route 501) connect the airport to central Jeddah and King Abdulaziz University. Fares are 4–8 SAR. The Jeddah Metro is under construction, with airport service expected by 2030.

Car Rentals

Company Location Operating Hours
Hertz Terminal 1 & North Terminal arrivals 24 hours
Avis All terminals arrivals level 6:00 AM - 2:00 AM
Budget Terminal 1 arrivals 24 hours
Thrifty North & South terminals 6:00 AM - 1:00 AM
Lumi Rental Terminal 1 7:00 AM - 11:00 PM

International driving licenses are accepted for tourists; residents require a Saudi license. Rental rates start from approximately 120–180 SAR per day for economy vehicles.

Parking Information (Short-term, Long-term, Valet, Charges)

KAIA offers over 11,000 parking spaces across short-term, long-term, economy, and premium valet zones. Online pre-booking is available for discounts and guaranteed spaces.

Parking Type Duration Rate (SAR) Location
Short-term First 2 hours free, then 5/hour 50 max/day Adjacent to terminals
Long-term Daily rate 30/day Multi-level structures
Economy Daily rate 20/day Remote lots with shuttle
Premium Valet Full service 150/day Terminal entrances

Covered parking is available in multi-level structures. Payment options include cash, credit cards, and mobile apps. EV charging stations are in premium areas, with expansion planned. Accessible parking is located near terminal entrances.

Airport Maps & Navigation Help

Interactive airport maps are available on the official KAIA website and mobile app, providing real-time navigation, gate locations, and amenities. Digital kiosks and information desks are located throughout all terminals for on-site assistance. Signage is in Arabic and English, with clear wayfinding to transfer shuttles, baggage claim, and transportation zones.

Customer service is available 24/7 in Arabic and English. Real-time updates and inquiries are also available via Twitter (@JedAirport) and Instagram. Emergency numbers are displayed throughout the airport and accessible via the KAIA mobile app.
